Part: Blower, 12 V BLDC with built-in driver
Facts from the datasheet (page): 12 VDC. Free blowing: 45000 rpm, 1.6 A +-15 %, 120 L/min +-10 %. At static pressure: 49000 rpm +-5 %, 0.9 A +-30 %, 5.0 kPa +-10 %. Working point 3.5 kPa: 47000 rpm, 1.3 A +-15 %, 82 L/min. Wires 20 AWG, 150 +-20 mm: pin1 yellow VSR 0-3.3 V, pin2 white FG (1 Hz x 60 = speed), pin3 black GND, pin4 red +12 V
Status: Verified against the drawing. The drawing does not say whether FG is open-collector: measure FG with the blower alone before connecting it (check_harness.py OPEN item)

Facts from the datasheet (page): Supply 5 V +-5 %; I2C address 0x40, max 400 kHz; I/O high >= 2.5 V, low <= 1.1 V (p.3). Pads HEAT_GND, VDD, SCK, GND, DATA, HEAT at 2.54 mm (p.4). Fittings per ISO 5356-1, 15/22 mm medical cones (p.5). Sensirion supplies no mating connector (p.5, 3.2). Cable as short as possible, max 30 cm, SDA/SCL shielded if longer than 10 cm (p.6, 4.8)

Status: NOT VERIFIED: pin order VCC-GND-SCL-SDA, 3.3/5 V input and address 0x3C come from notes in wiring_harness.md, not from an official document. Get the maker's datasheet (and the SSD1306 one) before buying

Part: Pressure tubing to a shared T-fitting
Facts from the datasheet (page): Sensor port outside diameter W = 2.92-3.17 mm (MPX5010 DS p.7, case 482A). The enclosure README plans silicone 3 x 5 mm: an inside diameter of 3 mm is larger than the 2.92 mm minimum port, so it may not seal.
